feed.title: NPR Topics: World
feed.subtitle: International news, global reporting and analysis from NPR. Plus dispatches from NPR’s State of the World podcast.

entry.title: Israel's Arab-led parties in spotlight after inconclusive election
entry.summary: Israel's center-right opposition has a chance to unseat Netanyahu — but backing of Arab-led parties will be key

entry.title: Pope Leo begins a 12-day, 3-country South America tour after his cancer surgery
entry.summary: Pope Leo begins his first South American tour since lung cancer surgery. The 12-day journey takes him to Uruguay, Argentina and Peru, where he spent two decades.

entry.title: Health intel-sharing group warns industry in wake of cyberattack on French blood bank
entry.summary: A healthcare intelligence-sharing organization is warning its members to lock down systems following cyberattacks on cold storage systems, including a French blood bank.

entry.title: European flights and broadcasters are targeted with another wave of bomb threats
entry.summary: Officials across Europe reported a slew of bomb threats against multiple flights, following a string of hoaxes that caused flight diversions this week. Three broadcasters also received threats.

entry.title: The leader of a Kenyan doomsday cult is sentenced to 200 years in prison
entry.summary: Cult leader Paul Mackenzie was convicted of murdering 190 children and one adult after he ordered his followers to starve themselves to death in order to meet Jesus.

entry.title: Ex-lawmaker gets 12.5 years in Macao's first national security case
entry.summary: Au's arrest last year was the first publicly known prosecution under Macao's national security law since it was enacted in 2009.

entry.title: Judge halts construction of Trump's arch. And, Labor Department to release jobs report
entry.summary: A judge has blocked construction of Trump's arch moments after it won federal approval to proceed. And, the Labor Department is set to release the latest jobs report today, a day after stocks plunged.

entry.title: After cancer surgery, Pope Leo embarks on Latin America trip
entry.summary: Pope Leo XIV is kicking off a three-nation tour of Latin America with a visit to Uruguay, three weeks after undergoing lung cancer surgery that had put the entire trip into question.

entry.title: Paraguay's president is impeached minutes after resigning following a bank collapse
entry.summary: Paraguayan lawmakers voted to impeach President Santiago Peña minutes after his resignation, as the collapse of a digital bank tied to his government froze millions of people's savings.

entry.title: From comedian to convicted rapist: What to know about Russell Brand
entry.summary: On Monday Brand will learn his sentence, which a judge has warned will likely be 'significant.' It comes after a London jury found him guilty this week on multiple counts of sexual assault and one count of rape.
